name: open-context-engine
description: AI-powered codebase indexing, semantic search, and context-aware chat

viewsWelcome.contents: No files indexed yet. [Index Workspace](command:openContext.indexWorkspace) or [Select Folder to Index](command:openContext.selectIndexWorkspace)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Open Context
walkthroughs.description: Index your codebase, configure API keys, and start chatting with context-aware AI.

steps.title: Open the Chat panel
steps.description:
Open the **Open Context** sidebar and select **Chat** to start a conversation grounded in your local code index.

[Open Chat](command:openContext.openChat)

steps.title: Index your workspace
steps.description:
Build a local semantic index of your codebase. Indexing runs on your machine — your code never leaves your device.

[Index Workspace](command:openContext.indexWorkspace)

steps.title: Set up API keys
steps.description:
Add your LLM and embedding API keys so search and chat can run. Keys are stored securely via VS Code SecretStorage.

[Open Settings](command:openContext.openSettings)

steps.title: Browse indexed files
steps.description:
Expand **Indexed Files** in the Open Context sidebar to see what's in your index. Right-click a file to re-index or remove it.

[Show Indexed Files](command:workbench.view.extension.openContext)

enumDescriptions: Voyage AI embeddings (recommended for code, supports voyage-code-3)
Ollama local embeddings (requires a running Ollama server)
In-process local embeddings (ONNX — no API key, no server; needs the optional @huggingface/transformers package)
Voyage code-3 (recommended, 32K context, best for code)
Nomic embed text via Ollama (768 dim)
Jina embeddings v2 base code — in-process local, code-tuned (768 dim)
all-MiniLM-L6-v2 — in-process local, small and fast (384 dim)

openContext.embedding.cache.enabled.markdownDescription: Cache embeddings by content hash in `~/.open-context/embed-cache.db`, shared across repos and branches on this machine — identical code never embeds (or bills) twice.

openContext.embedding.apiKey.markdownDescription: Embedding API key. **Deprecated:** use the command *Open Context: Set Embedding API Key* so the key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
openContext.embedding.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use the command 'Open Context: Set Embedding API Key' instead; plain-text settings are synced and not secure.

enumDescriptions: Ollama — fully local, no API key (llama3.1, qwen2.5-coder, …)
Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, LM Studio, etc.)
openContext.llm.provider.description: LLM provider for chat and agent

openContext.llm.model.markdownDescription:
LLM model for chat and agent. Common choices:

**OpenAI:** `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.4-mini`, `gpt-5.4-nano`, `gpt-5-codex`, `gpt-5.3-codex`, `gpt-5.1-codex-max`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-4.1`

**Anthropic:** `claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-haiku-4-5`

**Google:** `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, `gemini-3-flash-preview`, `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview`, `gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`

**Custom:** any model ID supported by your OpenAI-compatible endpoint

openContext.llm.baseUrl.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible custom LLM endpoints (e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1). Used when llm.provider is custom.

openContext.llm.apiKey.markdownDescription: LLM API key. **Deprecated:** use the command *Open Context: Set LLM API Key* so the key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
openContext.llm.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use the command 'Open Context: Set LLM API Key' instead; plain-text settings are synced and not secure.

openContext.agent.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool-use steps per agent turn

openContext.agent.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens per agent LLM call

openContext.agent.historyTokenBudget.description: Approximate token budget for conversation history; older messages are compacted when exceeded

openContext.agent.maxToolResultChars.description: Maximum characters from a tool result kept in history (longer results are truncated with a marker)

openContext.agent.maxRetries.description: Maximum retries on transient LLM errors (429, 5xx, network)

openContext.agent.allowEdits.description: Give the agent tools to edit, create, and delete files in the workspace

openContext.agent.shell.enabled.markdownDescription: Give the agent a `run-command` tool to execute non-interactive shell commands in the workspace root. **Off by default** — enabling it lets the model run arbitrary commands on your machine unless you also set `#openContext.agent.shell.allowlist#`.

openContext.agent.shell.allowlist.markdownDescription: Allowlist of command names the agent may run (e.g. `["npm","git","ls"]`). Empty means any command is allowed. Matching is done against the first whitespace-delimited token in the command string.

openContext.agent.shell.timeoutMs.description: Default timeout for each shell command in milliseconds (1000..300000)

openContext.agent.audit.enabled.markdownDescription: Append every agent run and tool call to a tamper-evident local audit log (`.open-context/audit/audit.jsonl`, hash-chained). Requires an Enterprise license; a workspace policy can also force it on. Inspect with `oce audit` / `oce audit --verify`.

openContext.agent.routing.enabled.markdownDescription: Route each query to a cost-appropriate model tier: cheap lookups go to a fast model, multi-file/analytical work to the strongest one. Off by default so model usage stays predictable — your configured `openContext.llm.model` is the standard tier.

openContext.agent.routing.fastModel.description: Model for the fast tier (empty = provider default, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5 / gpt-5.4-mini)

openContext.agent.routing.reasoningModel.description: Model for the reasoning tier (empty = provider default, e.g. claude-opus-4-7)

openContext.agent.memory.enabled.markdownDescription: Remember codebase insights across chat sessions (stored locally in `.open-context/memories.json`). Relevant memories are injected into the agent's context per query.

openContext.agent.webSearch.enabled.description: Give the agent a web-search tool backed by Tavily (requires API key in the chat settings drawer)

openContext.search.topK.description: Number of search results to return
